properties_contribution_detail.basis_tie_out: Reading A: 3,280,000 BEFORE the 752(b) shift, less 19,000 = 3,261,000 AFTER the shift; Reading B: 1,520,000 less 19,000 = 1,501,000. The 'after' figures are the ones used in the gift table below and in mortgage_payoff_after_exit, where they become 5,161,000 / 3,401,000 once the 1,900,000 cash contribution is added. Reading A measures inside asset basis and therefore EXCLUDES the mortgage from basis; Reading B measures stated tax capital plus her share of the debt and therefore INCLUDES it - that is the only difference in convention between the two readings. All four figures are Properties-level: they exclude the 12,000 Helio share basis, which can only raise basis and make the 0 answers safer. imputed_interest_detail.partial_year_arithmetic: Day-count convention used for the indicative prior-year figures (indicative only, not a proper 7872 accrual): simple interest, 365-day denominator throughout, a full year for an advance made before the year, and days elapsed since the advance date (advance date not counted, Dec. 31 counted) for an advance made during the year. 2024 Properties: 250,000 x 4.12% x 305/365 = 8,606.85 (advance 2024-03-01, 305 days elapsed to 2024-12-31). 2024 Digital: no advance existed before 2025-09-01, so 0. 2025 Properties: 250,000 x 4.12% = 10,300.00 for the full year, plus 150,000 x 4.12% x 199/365 = 3,369.37 (199 days from 2025-06-15), total 13,669.37. 2025 Digital: 150,000 x 4.12% x 121/365 = 2,048.71 (121 days from 2025-09-01). 2024 is a leap year; using a 366-day denominator for that stub instead would give 8,583.33 - the difference is not material and neither figure is a compliant accrual.
imputed_interest_detail.note: Simple annual interest, full-year 2026 balances. The partial-year figures above are INDICATIVE ONLY: the library does not state which AFR term applies to an undocumented demand loan, nor the accrual/compounding method, nor any de minimis exception, so prior-year amounts are left open pending the CPA's records (QUESTIONS.md R2). The whole 22,660 figure is contingent: if all three LLCs stay single-member and disregarded (the likely result under section 8.2), Nadia stands on both sides of every loan and the imputed interest is 0; the exposure begins when a genuine second owner or a true partnership exists.

assumptions: (1) The library is the only authority relied on; items marked [UNVERIFIED] in opinion.md are not supported by it. (2) Helio Grid stock meets IRC 1202(c)(1) on the client file as it stands - Delaware C corp, shares issued directly by the company 2020-02-18 for $12,000 cash, company's SPA 2.3 representation that gross assets did not exceed $1,000,000 at issuance and that it was engaged in the active conduct of a qualified trade or business; holding period >5 years as of 2025-02-18; the 100% tier therefore applies per 1202(a) for stock acquired after 9/27/2010, and the $15,000,000 cap figure is inapplicable because the issuance predates 7/4/2025. (3) The 409A value of $9,400,000 is used as the point proxy for sale proceeds; the client's 2026-10-25 estimate of $9,000,000-$10,000,000 for her stake is carried as the exit_scenarios range, and gain is finally measured on an actual sale. (4) No tax rates are in the library - the 20% / 23.8% / 40% figures are illustrative assumptions, and Colorado tax on the gain is not quantified because neither the Colorado rate nor whether Colorado conforms to IRC 1202 is in the library. (5) IRC 752 liability shift is taken at the library's stated 99/1 arithmetic (1% of the $1,900,000 mortgage = $19,000); no other nonrecourse-liability allocation rule is in the library. The client confirms she is not personally liable on the mortgage, which removes any recourse-liability element but does not resolve the nonrecourse allocation question. (6) Outside basis in Oakline Properties is stated as a range because the Properties balance sheet does not reconcile (unexplained 1,760,000 difference); the 731(a) gain of 0 holds on both readings, but a large transfer of Holdings interests does gain on the lower reading. (7) Imputed interest uses the mid-term AFR of 4.12% given for this engagement, simple annual interest, full-year 2026 balances; the loans are undocumented demand advances. (8) The three Oakline LLCs are treated as owned 100% by Nadia (single-member, disregarded) today. (9) The 1% member is Nadia's own revocable living trust (client confirmed 2026-10-25); the library does not address grantor trusts or the two-bona-fide-partner requirement, so Holdings is treated as probably disregarded, and every number that depends on partnership status (752(b) shift, 1065 filing, 7872 imputed interest) is presented with both branches. (10) Nothing here addresses gift/estate tax, securities/transfer-restriction, or employment matters; those are outside the library. (11) The client expects an exit in 12-18 months and reports she has no further information on the open factual items; those are carried as limitations in QUESTIONS.md rather than re-asked. (12) Whether the proposed steps have already been executed (documents/org_chart.md carries a 'Step 1: Wyoming' note dated 2025-11-04) is unresolved; if Oakline Holdings already exists and holds anything, the Helio analysis must be redone immediately.
